content.title: Data Center Adjunct Touches Buy Point As Analyst Calls It A Buy
content.summary: Shares of Primoris Services reached a buy point Tuesday after an analyst upgraded the stock, a play on data center growth.  A Guggenheim analyst upgraded the heavy construction company to buy from a neutral rating, according to Dow Jones Newswires.  The Guggenheim note placed a 160 price target on the stock, which traded around 137 Tuesday morning.
